summary: OpenAI published detailed case studies illustrating the question design, prompts, and supporting datasets underlying its GeneBench-Pro genomics benchmark.

practices.reason: The document lays out concrete genomics benchmark prompts and grading formulas that could inform how a team building genomics-adjacent AI evaluates model reasoning quality, though it is a narrow domain-specific instrument.
practices.quote: These 10 case studies showcase representative questions from GeneBench-Pro. Each case study includes the original prompt, datasets, and supporting materials.
